name: Polynomial Factorization
description: For when you want to play GD but you have a math test tomorrow

issues.info: If you find any bugs in the mod please report them at our Github issues page!

polynomial-degree.name: Degree
polynomial-degree.description: The highest power the polynomial should have. (This is also how many solutions the equation should have, but that doesn't mean it makes it easier!)

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: How many attempts you can do before the next polynomial appears

range.name: Range
range.description: The range of numbers that can be selected as answers, going from positive range to negative range (inclusive).
